note: Each context is sorted on its own: o1 has no Tag, o2 has c, a and o3 has b. S1 keeps the empty context and the boundaries, so All is a, c, b; one sort over all values would give a, b, c. R1 joins the contexts S1 keeps, so All shows each context's order in turn. Observe in SAP PO (#33).
